items.text: Ravens QB Lamar Jackson listed as full participant for second straight day after missing three games with ankle injury; poised to return Sunday vs Bills.
items.why: Full practice participation two days in a row
items.implication: Unlocks Ravens offense and Zay Flowers upside
items.opportunity: Increased targets/routes for Flowers and Henry volume

items.text: Patriots WR AJ Brown DNP Thursday with flared knee issue (also ankle); status for Sunday vs Dolphins up in the air after limited Wednesday.
items.why: Knee flare-up added to ankle; first missed practice since IR return
items.opportunity: If OUT, boosts other NE pass-catchers

items.text: Christian Watson returned after leaving with rib injury/coughing blood (cleared CT); Thorman noted visual concern for collarbone but he played heroically.
items.why: Cleared checks, returned third quarter; broke rib but played on
items.implication: Toughness shown but monitor next week availability

items.text: Jaylen Waddle on Berry HATE list; production lacking and Chiefs allowed just one WR TD all season (to JSN).
items.why: Poor recent production + tough Chiefs secondary (chest injury uncertainty noted elsewhere)
items.opportunity: Limited if active vs elite coverage

items.text: Bengals WR Ja'Marr Chase full participant Thursday one day after DNP (rest/ankle).
items.why: Upgraded to full after Wednesday rest day
items.implication: Clears for Week 8 start vs Titans

items.text: Zay Flowers is Berry's WR5 this week; Loves what Lamar Jackson's expected return means for him.
items.why: Lamar unlock in track-meet Bills matchup

items.text: Seahawks designated RB Jadarian Price for return to practice.
Colston Loveland averaging 30% target share and 19.2 PPG in two games since Caleb Williams return; top-5 TE both weeks, leads utilization.
Jaxon Smith-Njigba ripping 9 more actual fantasy points than opportunity implies despite losing OC Klint Kubiak, limited threats, and shaded coverage; entire stadium knows ball is going to him.
items.why: Elite efficiency overcoming opportunity/OC loss and defensive attention
items.implication: Sustained WR1 value ROS even in tougher environment

items.text: Packers WR Matthew Golden active for Thursday night vs Panthers after questionable (shoulder/foot).
items.why: Cleared and active on inactives list

items.text: Derrick Henry LOVE/RB6 vs Bills; history and run defense weakness.
items.why: Favorable run matchup and Lamar return boost

items.text: Chase Brown LOVE/RB8 vs Titans; due for TD luck in good spot.
items.why: Soft run defense and TD regression candidate

items.text: Saquon Barkley HATE/RB20 @ WSH; usage concerns amid Eagles injuries (Pierce IR).
ETR (Levitan/Silva): Time to move forward with Jonah Coleman in DEN backfield after return; led snaps (50%) and touches (11) in first game back, better YPC than Harvey/Dobbins.
items.why: Coleman leading snaps/touches and efficiency on return from IR
